description: Use this when a buyer wants to return a work or report a problem with an order: damage or a difference from the description on arrival, non-delivery, a doubt about authenticity or title, an agent purchase they did not authorise, cancelling before dispatch, or a 30-day return. It checks the ground against the Returns policy’s window for this order, records the request for a person at Fold, and answers with a link for sending photographs. It refunds nothing: a person at Fold decides every request and replies by e-mail. Needs the same proof as get_order_status.

buyer_email.description: The e-mail address the buyer gave at checkout. Send with order_reference.

description.description: What went wrong, in the buyer’s words.

ground.description: The ground, as Returns §2 names it.

order_reference.description: The order reference printed in the confirmation e-mail. Send with buyer_email.

order_token.description: The token in the order page’s address, from the confirmation e-mail: /order/<token>.

name: open_claim
title: Open a return or claim
